metadata.disclaimer: IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: (1) This reference file is based on sampling-based audit (50 of 260 references exhaustively verified). While statistically significant, not all references were individually verified. (2) Source accessibility: 25% of primary sources (Bursa Malaysia, KLCC REIT website) had access restrictions during audit; some facts rely on data aggregator information. (3) Market data (share prices, yields, market caps) are time-sensitive and were accurate as of 2026-04-25; values change daily. (4) Some references rely on secondary sources (analyst reports, industry benchmarks) rather than primary filings. (5) Appropriate rounding used for percentages and calculations. Users should verify critical facts against original sources before making investment decisions.
